purpose: Rank the biggest unsolved agent painpoints likely to get immediate attention from first external agents/builders.

painpoints.painpoint: MCP/tool calls executing or appearing to execute without trustworthy approval boundaries
painpoints.attention_trigger: Agents and users fear invisible side effects; security gateways are getting public attention.
evidence: HN: Cordon/Kvlar/AgentArmor MCP security Show HN results
painpoints.outreach_hook: Run one command to prove risky tools fail closed when auto-approve is off.

painpoints.painpoint: Provider/host tool vocabulary mismatch breaks otherwise capable models
painpoints.attention_trigger: Agents waste turns saying execute_command/write_to_file when provider cannot dispatch those tools.
painpoints.outreach_hook: Paste your provider/host pair and get a translation map plus failing call proof.

painpoints.painpoint: Stale checkpoint/structured output state causes premature exits or wrong next-turn behavior
painpoints.attention_trigger: Framework users lose trust when agents stop or reuse stale structured_response data.
painpoints.outreach_hook: Generate a before/after checkpoint replay pack agents can attach to framework issues.

painpoints.painpoint: Runtime/browser/terminal workflow hangs with weak completion evidence
painpoints.attention_trigger: Agents stuck in running state waste money and make CI/browser agents feel unreliable.
painpoints.outreach_hook: Turn a stuck run log into exit/callback/state evidence in one artifact.

painpoints.painpoint: File/path metadata and tool schemas leak security or serialization failures into agent runs
painpoints.attention_trigger: RAG/agent developers hit arbitrary file-read and no-parameter tool spec bugs.
painpoints.outreach_hook: Validate file-path metadata and zero-arg tool schemas before publishing an agent.

painpoints.painpoint: First-run install/package failures block adoption before an agent can test the product
painpoints.attention_trigger: No one adopts if npm/pip/CLI startup fails or package name is unclear.
painpoints.next_build: copy-paste installer with registry fallback matrix
painpoints.outreach_hook: If install fails, attach this doctor output instead of a vague bug report.
